response.sql:
WITH eligible_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
), patient_averages AS (
  SELECT l.ID,
         AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
         AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_patient_pt_averages,
       AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_of_patient_tat_difference_averages
FROM patient_averages;

assumptions.assumption: A patient qualifies if at least one laboratory record has both U-PRO exactly '-' and RA exactly '-'. The per-patient averages then use all that patient's laboratory records; SQL AVG ignores nulls, and TAT − TAT2 is null if either value is missing.
